mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_order (student_id, repair_type, description, images, address_snapshot, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{repairType}, #{description}, #{images}, #{addressSnapshot}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.phone AS studentPhone FROM repair_order r LEFT JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT r.*, s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.phone AS studentPhone FROM repair_order r LEFT JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.id
AND status = #{status}
AND s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT CASE status WHEN 0 THEN '待处理' WHEN 1 THEN '已接单' WHEN 2 THEN '维修中' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' END AS name, COUNT(id) AS value FROM repair_order GROUP BY status

select r.*, s.name as studentName, s.student_no as studentNo, s.phone as studentPhone from repair_order r left join student s on r.student_id = s.id
and status = 0
and status = #{dto.status} and worker_id = #{workerId}
and (status = 0 or worker_id = #{workerId})
order by create_time desc
